Class LimitKeyDefinition

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.dto.LimitKeyDefinition
public class LimitKeyDefinition extends Object
Everything the admin edit form needs to offer one limit key and validate a value entered for it. Returned by GET /entitylimit/keys.

A bare key/value pair such as ValueKeyHtmlSelectOptions cannot carry this: picking a key fixes four of the five key columns as read-only fields of the form, and the value the admin types has to be validated against the rule that belongs to the key rather than to the row.
